recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus portrait of a smiling man in light-colored clothing, framed by irregular, white-edged torn paper fragments. The composition uses a layered collage effect where text is placed on dark, jagged paper strips that appear to be ripped from a different surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Soft portrait photography against a pastel pink background
Rough, white deckle edges of torn paper framing the central subject
High-contrast dark paper strips hosting light-colored typography
Warm skin tones balanced by cool, desaturated background elements
coreInvariants: Visible white paper fiber at the tear lines
Soft, diffused lighting on the subject
Pastel pink border framing the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot of a male figure, scaled to occupy approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, positioned in the upper-center quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the bottom torn strip, then travel up the right side to the top torn strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant pastel pink negative space on the left and right margins, defined by vertical tear lines.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal/black for the torn text strips.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream and light tan in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value pastels, punctuated by low-value dark strips for legibility.

composition.position: Top right and bottom left on dark strips
composition.rotation: 0 to 5 degrees following the tear angle
composition.overlap: Placed on top of dark paper texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used across different spatial locations to maintain unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity and historical accuracy for the era.
Open counters and clean geometric construction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a soft-focus portrait of a man in a tan blazer and pink polo shirt. Place this image inside a central vertical strip with ragged, white-fibered torn edges. Surround the central strip with a solid pastel pink background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two dark charcoal paper strips with jagged torn edges. Place one in the top right and one in the bottom left. Overlay uppercase geometric sans-serif text in light grey with wide tracking onto these strips.

verificationChecks: Are the paper edges visibly fibrous and white?
Is the text tracking sufficiently wide?
Is the overall color palette soft and pastel?
Do the dark strips look like physical paper scraps?

adjustableVariables: Width of the central torn image
Angle of the dark paper strips
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for white fiber detail on all torn edges
Ensure text is legible against the dark strips
Verify the soft-focus quality of the portrait
Confirm the pastel pink border is consistent
Check that the composition feels like a physical collage
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus portrait with a [Color] pastel border using [Torn Paper] edges. Anchor the design with [Dark Scraps] containing [Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif] typography.
